cds.title: Washington and Lee University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Accreditation and Institutional Research)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (CDS C1): 8,963 applied (4,600 men, 4,362 women, 1 unknown), 1,214 admitted, 499 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International: 4,472 applied, 80 admitted, 45 enrolled (matches the 45 nonresident first-years in B2). The ED figure covers Early Decision (C21: 1,048 applications, 289 admitted; W&L has no Early Action). W&L left the GPA table (C11) and the average GPA (C12) blank, so no GPA figures are shown. SAT/ACT is optional: 148 enrolled first-years (29.66%) submitted SAT and 111 (22.24%) submitted ACT. Undergraduate enrollment (1,916) and the nonresident count (168) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1/B2; College Scorecard shows 1,881.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $73,575, required fees $1,285, on-campus food and housing $20,575 (housing $10,580 + meal plan $9,995). Estimated expenses (G5): books and supplies $1,900, other expenses $2,545 (transportation left blank). Per-credit-hour tuition $2,628. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based grant aid is available to nonresidents; 160 degree-seeking nonresidents received it, average $90,617 (total $14,498,773), for the aid year ticked in H1 (2025-26 estimated or 2024-25 final; the tick position is unclear in the PDF text).
